en.t: Leo I becomes Eastern Roman emperor
en.s: On 7 February 457, Leo I was crowned Eastern Roman emperor at Hebdomon near Constantinople, in present-day Turkey, succeeding Marcian.

zh.t: 利奥一世成为东罗马皇帝
zh.s: 457年2月7日，利奥一世在君士坦丁堡附近的赫布多蒙加冕，继马尔西安之后成为东罗马皇帝。该地位于今土耳其。

en.t: Edward of Caernarfon granted the title Prince of Wales
en.s: On 7 February 1301, King Edward I granted his son Edward of Caernarfon, the future Edward II, the title Prince of Wales. This began the line of English royal heirs holding the title, following earlier native Welsh princes.

zh.t: 爱德华获封威尔士亲王
zh.s: 1301年2月7日，英格兰国王爱德华一世将威尔士亲王头衔授予儿子爱德华，即后来的爱德华二世。此前已有本土威尔士亲王，这次授封开启了英格兰王位继承人持有该头衔的传统。

en.s: On 7 February 1313, Thihathu was crowned king at Pinya in present-day Myanmar, claiming succession to the kings of Pagan. Queen Pwa Saw took part in the coronation.

zh.s: 1313年2月7日，梯诃都在今缅甸彬牙加冕为王，宣称继承蒲甘王朝的统治。蒲瓦索王后参与了加冕。

en.s: The Lam Sơn uprising was a rebellion against Ming China led by Vietnamese leader Lê Lợi. The uprising began in early 1418 and ended in late 1427 with the victory of the Lam Sơn rebels, the retreat of the Ming army after the Đông Quan oath, and the establishment of the Later Lê dynasty.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蓝山起义是越南领袖黎利领导的一场反抗明朝统治的起义。起义于1418年初爆发，1427年底以蓝山起义军获胜告终。东关誓约后，明军撤退，后黎朝建立。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Savonarola’s supporters hold a bonfire of the vanities in Florence
en.s: On 7 February 1497, supporters of Girolamo Savonarola collected and burned objects including cosmetics, art and books in a public square in Florence, Italy. The burning took place on Shrove Tuesday.

zh.t: 萨沃纳罗拉的支持者在佛罗伦萨焚烧物品
zh.s: 1497年2月7日，萨沃纳罗拉的支持者在意大利佛罗伦萨的公共广场收集并焚烧化妆品、艺术品和书籍等物品。这一天是四旬期前的忏悔星期二。

en.s: The Battle of Glen Fruin was fought on 7 February 1603 between the Clan Gregor and its allies on one side, and the Clan Colquhoun and its allies on the other. Glen Fruin is located in the Loch Lomond area, in the county of Dunbartonshire, Scotland.

zh.s: 1603年2月7日，格雷戈家族及其盟友，与科尔库恩家族及其盟友在弗鲁因峡谷交战。该峡谷位于苏格兰邓巴顿郡洛蒙德湖地区。

en.s: The Battle of Larache occurred on February 7, 1631, when the forces of Sidi M'hamed el-Ayachi ambushed a detachment of the Spanish garrison of Larache.

zh.s: 1631年2月7日，西迪·穆罕默德·阿亚希的部队伏击拉腊什西班牙驻军的一支分遣队，形成拉腊什战役。

en.s: The siege of Nakskov began on 6 February 1658, when a Swedish cavalry regiment under Överste Overbeck surrounded the city, and only one day later, the civilians in the town, not wanting to end up like Fredriksodde, which had been besieged and conquered by the Swedes, surrendered the city on February 7.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1658年2月6日，奥弗贝克上校率领的瑞典骑兵团包围纳克斯科夫。仅一天后，城中平民不愿落得腓特烈西亚被瑞典军队围困并攻占的下场，于2月7日交出城池。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 7 February 1783, French and Spanish forces lifted the Great Siege of Gibraltar, ending an unsuccessful effort to capture the British-held territory that had begun in 1779.

zh.s: 1783年2月7日，法国和西班牙军队解除对直布罗陀的围攻。这场始于1779年的围攻未能夺取英国控制的直布罗陀。

en.t: Eleventh Amendment to the US Constitution ratified
en.s: On February 7, 1795, the Eleventh Amendment to the United States Constitution reached the required number of state ratifications. It restricted federal judicial power over certain suits brought against a state by citizens of another state or by foreign citizens.

zh.t: 美国宪法第十一修正案获足够州批准
zh.s: 1795年2月7日，美国宪法第十一修正案获得所需数量的州批准。它限制联邦法院审理另一州公民或外国公民对某州提起的特定诉讼。

en.s: The Battle of Eylau (also known as the Battle of Preussisch-Eylau) was a bloody and strategically inconclusive battle on 7 and 8 February [O.S. 26 and 27 Jan.] 1807 between Napoleon's Grande Armée and the Imperial Russian Army under the command of General Levin August von Bennigsen near the town of Preussisch Eylau in East Prussia. Late in the battle, the Russians received timely reinforcements from a Prussian division of von L'Estocq.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 埃劳战役又称普鲁士埃劳战役，是拿破仑大军与列文·奥古斯特·冯·贝尼格森将军率领的俄罗斯帝国军队于1807年2月7日至8日在东普鲁士普鲁士埃劳镇附近进行的一场血腥战斗，双方在战略上未分胜负。战斗后期，冯·莱斯托克率领的普鲁士师及时增援俄军。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: In the action of 7 February 1813, two evenly matched frigates of the French Imperial Navy and Royal Navy, Aréthuse and HMS Amelia, engaged in a battle in the Atlantic Ocean at the Îles de Los, off Guinea. The action lasted four hours, causing significant damage and casualties to both opponents, and resulted in a stalemate. The two ships parted and returned to their respective ports of call, with both sides claiming victory.

zh.s: 1813年2月7日，法国帝国海军“阿瑞图斯”号与英国皇家海军“阿米莉亚”号两艘实力相当的护卫舰，在几内亚近海洛斯群岛的大西洋水域交战。战斗持续四小时，双方均遭严重损伤和人员伤亡，最终未分胜负。两舰分开后各自返回停靠港，双方都宣称获胜。

en.s: The Raid on Elizabethtown occurred on February 7, 1813, when Major Benjamin Forsyth and 200 regulars and militia crossed the frozen St. Lawrence River to occupy Elizabethtown, Upper Canada (present day Brockville, Ontario), seize military and public stores, free American prisoners and capture British military prisoners. This was the second successful raid by Forsyth along the St. Lawrence River, having previously attacked Gananoque.

zh.s: 1813年2月7日，本杰明·福赛思少校率领200名正规军和民兵渡过结冰的圣劳伦斯河，占领上加拿大的伊丽莎白镇（今安大略省布罗克维尔），缴获军用和公共物资，释放美国囚犯并俘虏英国军人。这是福赛思沿圣劳伦斯河实施的第二次成功突袭，此前他曾袭击甘纳诺克。

en.t: United States Senate election in New York, 1815
en.s: The 1815 United States Senate election in New York was held on February 7, 1815, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. Senator (Class 1) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.s: 1815年2月7日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出代表纽约州的第一组联邦参议员。

en.s: The Battle of Mejicanos or also known Combat of Mejicanos was a confrontation between Salvadoran troops and Mexican troops led by General Vicente Filísola during the Mexican annexation of El Salvador.

zh.s: 梅希卡诺斯战役，又称梅希卡诺斯战斗，是萨尔瓦多并入墨西哥期间，萨尔瓦多军队与文森特·菲利索拉将军率领的墨西哥军队之间的一场交战。

en.s: The Battle of Ayutuxtepeque took place during Filisola's campaign in El Salvador, it was a battle led by imperial troops under the command of Vicente Filísola, the Salvadoran troops under the command of Antonio José Cañas which ended in a Salvadoran defeat.

zh.t: 阿尤特斯特佩克战役（1823年）
zh.s: 阿尤特斯特佩克战役发生在菲利索拉远征萨尔瓦多期间。文森特·菲利索拉率领帝国军队与安东尼奥·何塞·卡尼亚斯率领的萨尔瓦多军队交战，最终萨尔瓦多军队战败。

en.s: On 7 February 1826, Congress elected Bernardino Rivadavia president of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, in present-day Argentina. The presidency had been established by a law passed the previous day.

zh.t: 国会选举里瓦达维亚为总统
zh.s: 1826年2月7日，国会选举贝纳迪诺·里瓦达维亚为拉普拉塔联合省总统，即今阿根廷。设立总统职位的法律于前一天通过。

loc: 埃塞俄比亚德布雷塔博尔

en.s: The Battle of Debre Tabor was a conflict during the Zemene Mesafint in 1842 initiated by Dejazmach Wube Haile Maryam to overthrow Ras Ali II as Regent of the Emperor of Ethiopia and gain control of Ethiopia. This confused battle was won by Ras Ali, but at a steep price, and this victory failed to cement his position as the most powerful warlord of his time. Dejazmach Wube's strategy against Ras Ali depended on his ability to import more firearms, which would provide him with a tactical superiority that would more than outweigh the vaunted cavalry of Ras Ali's Oromo kinsmen, and to obtain an Abuna for the Ethiopian Church, who would help unite the demoralized Christian population behind him.

zh.s: 1842年，埃塞俄比亚“王公时代”发生德布雷塔博尔战役。德贾兹马奇武贝·海尔·马里亚姆企图推翻皇帝摄政拉斯·阿里二世，夺取埃塞俄比亚控制权，因而发动战斗。混战以拉斯·阿里获胜告终，但代价高昂，也未能巩固他作为当时最强大军阀的地位。武贝的战略依赖进口更多火器，希望凭战术优势压倒拉斯·阿里著名的奥罗莫亲族骑兵；他还希望为埃塞俄比亚教会迎来一位阿布纳主教，以团结士气低落的基督徒支持自己。

en.t: Battle of the Col des Beni Aïcha (1846)
en.s: The Battle of the Col des Beni Aïcha or Battle of Thénia, which broke out on 3 February 1846, was a battle of the French conquest of Algeria between the Algerian rebels, and the France, which was the colonial power in the region since 1830.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 贝尼艾查山口战役又称泰尼亚战役，于1846年2月3日爆发，是法国征服阿尔及利亚期间阿尔及利亚叛军与法国之间的一场战斗。法国自1830年起成为该地区的殖民统治者。

en.t: Swiss law establishes the federal polytechnic that became ETH Zurich
en.s: On 7 February 1854, Switzerland approved the law establishing a federal polytechnic school, now ETH Zurich. The school began teaching in Zurich on October 16, 1855.
en.n: This records the founding legislation, not the first lectures in October 1855.

zh.t: 瑞士通过设立联邦理工学院的法律
zh.s: 1854年2月7日，瑞士通过设立联邦理工学院的法律，这所学校后来成为苏黎世联邦理工学院。学校于1855年10月16日在苏黎世开课。
zh.n: 此条记录设校法律通过，首次授课是在1855年10月。

en.s: The Battle of Khushab (Battle of Khoosh-Ab) took place on 7 February 1857 and was the largest single engagement of the Anglo-Persian War. Having taken Borazjan without a fight, the British expeditionary army under Sir James Outram was in the process of withdrawing to Bushehr when it was ambushed by a far larger Persian force under Khanlar Mirza, drawn up in battle order to its rear. The distinguishing action of the battle was the charge of the 3rd Bombay Light Cavalry (now amalgamated into The Poona Horse) against an infantry square of the 1st Khusgai Regiment of Fars, in which two Victoria Crosses were won.

zh.s: 胡沙布战役于1857年2月7日发生，是英波战争规模最大的一次单场交战。詹姆斯·欧特拉姆爵士率英国远征军不战而取博拉兹詹，撤往布什尔途中，在后方遭汉拉尔·米尔扎率领的兵力远超己方的波斯军伏击。战斗中最著名的一幕，是孟买第三轻骑兵团冲击法尔斯第一胡斯盖团步兵方阵，两名参战者因此获维多利亚十字勋章。该骑兵团后来并入浦那骑兵团。

en.s: The opening phase of what came to be called the Burnside Expedition, the Battle of Roanoke Island was an amphibious operation of the American Civil War, fought on February 7–8, 1862, in the North Carolina Sounds a short distance south of the Virginia border. The attacking force consisted of a flotilla of gunboats of the Union Navy drawn from the North Atlantic Blockading Squadron, commanded by Flag Officer Louis M. Goldsborough, a separate group of gunboats under Union Army control, and an army division led by Brig. Gen. Ambrose Burnside. The defenders were a group of gunboats from the Confederate States Navy, termed the Mosquito Fleet, under Capt.

zh.s: 罗阿诺克岛战役是美国内战的一次两栖作战，于1862年2月7日至8日在北卡罗来纳沿海水域进行，地点距弗吉尼亚边界以南不远。这是后来所称伯恩赛德远征的开端。进攻方包括路易斯·M.戈尔兹伯勒海军将官指挥、从联邦海军北大西洋封锁舰队抽调的炮艇编队，另一支归陆军指挥的炮艇队，以及安布罗斯·伯恩赛德准将率领的一个陆军师。守方为联盟海军一支被称为“蚊子舰队”的炮艇队。原文在介绍其舰长姓名前中断。

en.s: The Battle of Sosnowiec was one of battles of the January Uprising. It took place in the night of 6–7 February 1863, between Polish insurgents under Colonel Apolinary Kurowski, and the Imperial Russian Army garrison stationed in the town of Sosnowiec, in the Russian-ruled territory known officially as the ‘Kingdom of Poland’, otherwise Congress Poland. On 5 February 1863 Kurowski and his men left Ojców, and marched towards Olkusz.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 索斯诺维茨战役是波兰一月起义中的一场战斗，于1863年2月6日至7日夜间爆发。阿波利纳雷·库罗夫斯基上校率领波兰起义军，与驻扎在索斯诺维茨镇的俄罗斯帝国军队交战；该镇当时位于俄罗斯统治下、官方称为“波兰王国”（又称会议波兰）的领土上。1863年2月5日，库罗夫斯基和部下离开奥伊楚夫，向奥尔库什进军。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Siemiatycze was one of the largest battles of the January Uprising. It took place on February 6–7, 1863, in the town of Siemiatycze, Russian Empire (now Poland). Russian forces of some 2,500 under General Zachar Maniukin clashed with 4,000 Polish insurgents commanded by Walenty Lewandowski, Roman Roginski and Wladyslaw Cichorski-Zameczek.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 谢米亚蒂切战役是一月起义中规模最大的战斗之一，于1863年2月6日至7日在俄罗斯帝国境内的谢米亚蒂切镇（今属波兰）发生。扎哈尔·马纽金将军率领约2500名俄军，与瓦伦蒂·莱万多夫斯基、罗曼·罗金斯基和瓦迪斯瓦夫·齐霍尔斯基-扎梅切克指挥的4000名波兰起义军交战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On February 7, 1864, Union forces withdrew during the night after the Battle of Morton’s Ford in Virginia, United States. Fighting had begun the previous day and ended without a decisive result.
en.n: February 7 is the recorded endpoint of the February 6–7 battle.

zh.s: 1864年2月7日夜间，联邦军在美国弗吉尼亚州莫顿渡口战役后撤退。战斗于前一天开始，双方未分出明确胜负。
zh.n: 2月7日为这场2月6日至7日战役的结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Abtao was a naval battle fought on February 7, 1866, during the Chincha Islands War, between a Spanish squadron and a combined Peruvian-Chilean fleet, at the island of Abtao in the Gulf of Ancud near Chiloé Archipelago in south-central Chile. It reduced to a long-range exchange of fire between the two squadrons, as the Allied ships, anchored behind the island, were protected by shallow waters impracticable for the Spanish ships, whose gunnery, nevertheless, proved more accurate and inflicted damage to the Chilean and Peruvian ships.

zh.s: 1866年2月7日，钦查群岛战争期间，西班牙舰队与秘鲁、智利联合舰队在智利中南部奇洛埃群岛附近、安库德湾内的阿布陶岛交战。联军舰艇停泊在岛后，浅水使西班牙舰艇无法靠近，双方因而主要进行远距离炮击。不过西班牙炮火更为准确，对智利和秘鲁舰艇造成损伤。

en.s: The battle of Centane, also the battle of Kentani or the battle of Quintana, was fought on 7 February 1878 near Kentani ("Centane") in South Africa's Cape Province during the Ninth Xhosa War between 1877 and 1879. A Xhosa forces, composed of Gcalaka and Rharhabe warriors, attacked a British camp in the Centane Mountains and suffered a severe defeat.

zh.s: 森塔内战役又称肯塔尼战役或昆塔纳战役，于1878年2月7日在南非开普省肯塔尼附近爆发，是1877至1879年第九次科萨战争的一场战斗。加卡拉和拉哈尔贝科萨人袭击森塔内山脉的一处英军营地，遭到惨败。

en.s: The 1891 Scottish Cup final was played on 7 February 1891 at the second Hampden Park (now known as Cathkin Park) in Glasgow and was the final of the 18th season of the Scottish Cup. Hearts and Dumbarton contested the match. Hearts won the match 1–0, thanks to a 15th-minute goal from Willie Mason.

zh.s: 第18届苏格兰杯决赛于1891年2月7日在格拉斯哥第二座汉普登公园球场、即今天的卡思金公园举行，由哈茨对阵邓巴顿。凭借威利·梅森在第15分钟的进球，哈茨以1比0获胜。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 7 February 1899. Although Charilaos Trikoupis died in 1896, his supporters emerged as the largest bloc in Parliament, with 110 of the 235 seats, Georgios Theotokis, his successor as a leader of the New Party became Prime Minister after the election.

zh.s: 希腊于1899年2月7日举行议会选举。虽然哈里劳斯·特里库皮斯已于1896年去世，他的支持者仍组成议会最大集团，赢得235席中的110席。接替他担任新党领袖的乔治斯·西奥托基斯在选后出任首相。

en.s: The Battle of Vaal Krantz (Afrikaans: Slag van Vaalkrans, 5 - 7 February 1900) was the third failed attempt by General Redvers Buller's British army to fight its way past Louis Botha's army of Boer irregulars and lift the Siege of Ladysmith. The battle occurred during the Second Boer War.

zh.s: 瓦尔克兰茨战役（南非语：Slag van Vaalkrans，1900年2月5日至7日）是雷德弗斯·布勒将军率领的英军第三次试图突破路易斯·博塔的布尔人非正规军防线、解除莱迪史密斯围城。这次尝试以失败告终。战役发生在第二次布尔战争期间。

en.t: The Great Baltimore Fire begins in Baltimore, Maryland; it destroys over 1,500 buildings in 30 hours
en.s: The Great Baltimore Fire raged in Baltimore, Maryland from Sunday February 7 to Monday February 8, 1904. More than 1,500 buildings were completely leveled, and some 1,000 severely damaged, bringing property loss from the disaster to an estimated $100 million, or $3.6 billion in 2026. 1,231 firefighters helped bring the blaze under control, both professional paid truck and engine companies from the Baltimore City Fire Department (B.C.F.D.) and volunteers from surrounding counties and outlying towns, as well as out-of-state units that arrived on the major railroads.

en.s: The Maastricht Treaty (formally, the Treaty on European Union or TEU) undertaken to integrate Europe was signed on 7 February 1992 by the members of the European Community in Maastricht, Netherlands. en.s: The New Orleans mayoral election of 1998 was held on February 7, 1998, and resulted in the reelection of incumbent Marc Morial to a second term as Mayor of New Orleans. Elections in Louisiana—with the exception of U.S. presidential elections—follow a variation of the open primary system. Candidates of any and all parties are listed on one ballot; voters need not limit themselves to the candidates of one party. Unless one candidate takes more than 50% of the vote in the first round, a run-off election is then held between the top two candidates, who may in fact be members of the same party.

en.t: Crown Prince Abdullah becomes the King of Jordan on the death of his father, King Hussein
en.s: Abdullah II (Abdullah bin Hussein; born 30 January 1962) is the king of Jordan, having acceded to the throne on 7 February 1999. He is a member of the Hashemites, who have been the reigning royal family of Jordan since 1921, and is traditionally regarded as a 41st-generation direct descendant of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. Abdullah was born in Amman, as the first child of King Hussein and his wife, Princess Muna.

zh.s: 阿卜杜拉二世（阿卜杜拉·本·侯赛因，生于1962年1月30日）是约旦国王，于1999年2月7日继位。他属于哈希姆王朝，该王朝自1921年以来一直统治约旦。按传统说法，他是伊斯兰先知穆罕默德的第41代直系后裔。阿卜杜拉出生于安曼，是侯赛因国王与其妻穆娜公主的长子。

en.s: Costa Rica held parliamentary and presidential elections on February 7, 2010. The ruling party before the election, the center-left National Liberation Party, put forward former Vice-President Laura Chinchilla as its presidential candidate, while the libertarian, Movimiento Libertario nominated former legislator Otto Guevara. Opinion polls before voting started consistently put Chinchilla as the front-runner, a trend confirmed in the election-night count, which showed her garnering 46.76% of the vote. The election was supervised by observers from several countries, as well as from the Organization of American States. The incumbent President, Óscar Arias, was ineligible to run for a second consecutive term.

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Costa Rica on February 7, 2016 in order to elect the mayors of the 81 cantons of the country plus a proportional number of councilors in each of the canton’s municipal councils, a syndic for every district and members of the District Councils and a total of 8 Intendants for districts and islands located too far away from the administrative center. For the first time in history, election of councilors was held at the same time as the other municipal offices.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于2016年2月7日举行地方选举，选出全国81个县的市长，并按比例选出各县市议会议员，同时选出每个区的区议会主席及区议员，以及距离行政中心过远的地区和岛屿的八名行政长官。这是该国历史上市议员选举首次与其他地方职位选举同日举行。

en.s: Mayoral and municipal elections were held in San Jose, Costa Rica, on 7 February 2016 and were the method by which the citizens of the canton of San José elected the mayor, deputy mayors, syndics, aldermen and district councilors of the capital municipality. For the first time the elections of aldermen (traditionally elected at the same time as the president and the deputies) were joined by the other municipal authorities after the 2009 reform to the Municipal Code.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加圣何塞于2016年2月7日举行市长和地方选举，由圣何塞县居民选出首都市政府的市长、副市长、区议会主席、市议员和区议员。根据2009年《市镇法》改革，原本与总统和国会议员同时选举的市议员，首次改为与其他地方官员同日选出。

en.s: The 2016 African Nations Championship final was a football match to determine the winners of the CHAN 2016 tournament and took place on 7 February 2016. The match contested by DR Congo and Mali at the Amahoro Stadium in Kigali. DR Congo won the match 3–0, winning the title for the second time. DR Congo became the first nation to win the trophy twice, having won the inaugural CHAN tournament.

zh.s: 2016年非洲国家锦标赛决赛于2016年2月7日举行，决出该届赛事冠军。刚果民主共和国队与马里队在基加利的阿马霍罗体育场交锋，刚果民主共和国队以3比0获胜，第二次夺冠。刚果民主共和国队因此成为首支两度夺得该项赛事冠军的球队，此前他们赢得了首届赛事。

en.s: The 2016 Kyoto mayoral election was held on February 7, 2016. Incumbent mayor Daisaku Kadokawa ran for a third term, opposed by Independent and JCP politician Kumiko Honda and Independent Takashi Mikami. The total votes in the election were 398,988, a slight decrease in turnout compared to 2012. Kadokawa won by a wide margin compared to his 2012 election.

zh.s: 2016年2月7日，京都举行市长选举。现任市长门川大作竞选连任第三个任期，对手包括无党派人士、日本共产党政治人物本田久美子和无党派人士三上隆。此次选举共398,988张选票，投票率较2012年略有下降。门川大作以较大优势胜出，领先幅度高于2012年选举。

en.s: The 2016 Supertaça de Angola (29th edition) was contested by Recreativo do Libolo, the 2015 Girabola champion and Bravos do Maquis, the 2015 cup winner. Recreativo do Libolo was the winner, making it is's 2nd title in a row.

en.s: The Insurgency in Kabardino-Balkaria and Karachay-Cherkessia was a protracted conflict between Russian security forces and militant groups operating in the regions of Kabardino-Balkaria and Karachay-Cherkessia, located in the North Caucasus region of Russia. en.s: National Assembly elections were held in Nepal on 7 February 2018 across all seven provinces to form the first National Assembly since the adoption of the new constitution in 2015. According to Article 86 of the Constitution of Nepal 2015, the members of the National Assembly are elected every six years through an electoral college.

zh.s: 尼泊尔于2018年2月7日在全国七个省举行国民议会选举，组成2015年新宪法通过以来的首届国民议会。根据2015年宪法第86条，国民议会议员由选举人团选出，任期六年。

en.s: The 2021 Uttarakhand flood, also known as the Chamoli disaster, began on 7 February 2021 in the environs of the Nanda Devi National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the outer Garhwal Himalayas in Uttarakhand state, India. It was caused by a large rock and ice avalanche consisting of material dislodged from Ronti peak.

zh.s: 2021年北阿坎德邦洪灾又称杰莫利灾难，始于2月7日，地点在印度北阿坎德邦外加瓦尔喜马拉雅山区的南达德维国家公园附近。该公园是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。灾难由龙蒂峰脱落的大量岩石和冰体形成的巨大冰岩崩引发。

en.s: General elections were held in Ecuador on 7 February 2021, established by the National Electoral Council (CNE) as the date for the first round of the presidential election and a vote on mining in Cuenca. Incumbent president Lenín Moreno, who had held the office since his victory over Guillermo Lasso in 2017, did not seek reelection.

zh.s: 厄瓜多尔于2021年2月7日举行大选。全国选举委员会将这一天定为总统选举首轮投票日，昆卡也在同日就采矿问题投票。现任总统莱宁·莫雷诺自2017年击败吉列尔莫·拉索后任职，此次没有寻求连任。

en.s: The 2020 African Nations Championship final was a football match to determine the winners of the CHAN 2020 tournament and took place on 7 February 2021 at the Ahmadou Ahidjo Stadium in Yaoundé, Cameroon. It was contested by Mali and Morocco. Morocco won 2-0 to claim their second title. By doing so, they became the first team to win back-to-back titles since the tournament's inaugural edition in 2009.

zh.s: 2020年非洲国家锦标赛决赛于2021年2月7日在喀麦隆雅温得艾哈迈杜·阿希乔体育场举行，由马里与摩洛哥争夺冠军。摩洛哥以2比0获胜，第二次夺冠，也成为该赛事自2009年创办以来，首支连续两届夺冠的球队。

en.s: The 2021 Iranian Super Cup was the 7th Iranian Super Cup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Persian Gulf Pro League, Persepolis, and the previous season's Hazfi Cup, Foolad. Persepolis were the defending champions as winners of the 2020 Iranian Super Cup. Foolad defeated Persepolis 1–0 to win their first title.

zh.s: 2021年伊朗超级杯是第7届伊朗超级杯，每年由上赛季波斯湾职业联赛冠军波斯波利斯和哈兹菲杯冠军胡齐斯坦参加。波斯波利斯是2020年伊朗超级杯卫冕冠军。胡齐斯坦以1比0击败波斯波利斯，首次夺冠。

en.s: The Nduga hostage crisis began on 7 February 2023 when Free Papua Movement (Indonesian: Organisasi Papua Merdeka, OPM) insurgents attacked a plane and took its pilot and all five passengers hostage. While the passengers were soon released, New Zealander pilot Phillip Mark Mehrtens remained in captivity until 21 September 2024.

en.s: On 7 February 2024, twin bombings killed at least 30 people in Balochistan Province of Pakistan, targeting political campaign offices on the eve of the 2024 general election. At least 40 people were reported injured. The Islamic State – Pakistan Province (ISPP) claimed responsibility for both bombings, and said both attacks were carried out by motorbikes rigged with explosives.

zh.s: 2024年2月7日，巴基斯坦俾路支省发生两起爆炸，造成至少30人死亡。袭击目标是2024年大选前夕的竞选办公室。另有至少40人受伤。伊斯兰国巴基斯坦省分支声称对两起爆炸负责，并称袭击者骑着装有炸药的摩托车实施袭击。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Azerbaijan on 7 February 2024. Incumbent president Ilham Aliyev, who has held office since 2003, won a fifth consecutive term with over 92% of the vote, defeating his closest runner-up Zahid Oruj, who obtained just 2% of the vote. Originally planned for October 2025, President Aliyev called for a snap election in December 2023 following the victorious Azerbaijani offensive in Nagorno-Karabakh.

zh.s: 阿塞拜疆于2024年2月7日举行总统选举。自2003年起执政的现任总统伊利哈姆·阿利耶夫以超过92%的得票率赢得第五个连续任期，击败得票仅为2%的主要对手扎希德·奥鲁杰夫。选举原计划于2025年10月举行，阿利耶夫总统在2023年12月纳戈尔诺—卡拉巴赫攻势获胜后宣布提前举行选举。

zh.s: 第39届圣巴巴拉国际电影节是2024年举办的一届电影节，于2024年2月7日至17日在美国加利福尼亚州圣巴巴拉举行。2023年11月和12月公布了荣誉奖项：布莱德利·库珀获年度杰出演员奖；瑞恩·高斯林获柯克·道格拉斯电影杰出成就奖；莉莉·格莱斯顿、达'维恩·乔伊·伦道夫、葛丽泰·李、查尔斯·梅尔顿、丹妮尔·布鲁克斯、科尔曼·多明戈、亚美莉卡·费雷拉和安德鲁·斯科特获“新星奖”。

At least 20 Malian soldiers were killed or injured along with a similar number of militants, and 34 civilians were killed during the attack.

zh.s: 2025年2月7日，疑似“伊斯兰国”萨赫勒省的武装人员，在马里加奥与昂松戈之间的科贝附近，袭击一支由马里军队和瓦格纳集团人员护送的平民车队。至少20名马里士兵伤亡，武装人员也有大致相同人数伤亡，另有34名平民死亡。

en.t: 2025 Turks and Caicos Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the Turks and Caicos Islands on 7 February 2025 to determine the composition of the Parliament of the Turks and Caicos Islands. Significant constitutional changes meant they were the first general election in which nine at-large MPs were elected.

en.s: The 2025 President of Ireland's Cup was the eleventh edition of the President of Ireland's Cup. The match was played on 7 February between the champions of the 2024 League of Ireland Premier Division, Shelbourne, and the 2024 FAI Cup winners, Drogheda United, at Tolka Park. Shelbourne won the game 2-0 to win the Cup for the first time.

zh.s: 2025年爱尔兰总统杯是第11届赛事。比赛于2月7日在托尔卡公园举行，由2024年爱尔兰足球超级联赛冠军谢尔本对阵2024年爱尔兰足协杯冠军德罗赫达联。谢尔本以2比0获胜，首次夺得该项杯赛冠军。

en.s: The Quark 2025 Chinese FA Super Cup (Chinese: 夸克2025中国足球协会超级杯) was the 20th Chinese FA Super Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Chinese Super League and FA Cup competitions. The match was played between Shanghai Port, champions of the 2024 Chinese Super League and the winner of the 2024 Chinese FA Cup, and Shanghai Shenhua, the runners-up of the 2024 Chinese Super League.

zh.s: 夸克2025中国足协超级杯是第20届中国足协超级杯，由上赛季中超和足协杯冠军交锋。参赛球队是2024年中超冠军上海海港和2024年足协杯冠军、同时也是2024年中超亚军的上海申花。
